infra_notes: City-wide Gurugram average rate: Rs.8,288/sqft (Q3 2022) -> Rs.11,055/sqft (Q3 2023) -> Rs.14,650/sqft (Q3 2024) = +32.5% YoY (Q3'23-Q3'24) and +76.7% over two years, driven by Dwarka Expressway completion improving connectivity to Delhi. By property sub-type (Q3 2024): Builder Floor Rs.12,700/sqft, Multi-storey Apartment Rs.13,200/sqft, Residential House Rs.16,100/sqft, Villa Rs.25,600/sqft. Most recent available trend (Jan-Mar 2026 sample report, same repo): Gurugram demand -2.0% QoQ, supply +10.1% QoQ (strong new-launch activity), price -0.3% QoQ — a mild cooling/correction after the 2022-2024 surge, not a reversal of the multi-year uptrend.
